proposal.expected_benefit: Reduces potential conflicts in decision-making during consensus divergence by ensuring audit status and emergency stop signals are fully aligned, thereby improving system safety and reliability.
proposal.problem: Ambiguity in how audit status interacts with emergency stop decisions during consensus divergence.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a clear protocol that explicitly defines how audit status influences emergency stop decisions. This includes defining conditions under which audit status overrides or aligns with emergency stop signals, ensuring consistent and predictable behavior during consensus divergence.
proposal.title: Clarify Audit Status Integration with Emergency Stop Decisions
verification_tests: Validate audit status integration with emergency stop signals under simulated consensus divergence scenarios.
Ensure that audit status overrides or aligns with emergency stop signals as per defined conditions.
